author: MomoandGemini
name: ShowTix
short: Manages Camshow tickets and channel access.
description: Assigns a Camshow role for voice/text channel access, tracks guests in a thread, and clears the guest list monthly.
install_msg: ShowTix installed! Use `[p]showtix setup` to get the box office running.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord User IDs temporarily to track channel access, clearing them monthly.
